Questions, answered.

What tenants and investors ask us most, answered in full.

Applicants generally need a 560+ credit score, stable verifiable income, and a positive rental history.

Tour the home, apply online, complete screening, sign your lease, and move in.

Most security deposits equal one month's rent, but requirements vary by property.

Many of our homes are pet-friendly, subject to property-specific policies and fees.

Most of our properties do not participate in the Housing Choice Voucher (Section 8) program. Please check individual listings for updates.

Rent and deposits are paid through our secure property management software. In limited circumstances, we may accommodate Venmo or Zelle.

Payment plan requests are considered on a case-by-case basis and are not guaranteed.

Residents submit maintenance requests quickly and easily through our online tenant portal.

We offer both debt investments and equity partnership opportunities, depending on the project and investor objectives.

Debt investments have historically targeted 8–12% annual returns, while equity partnerships have higher potential returns.

Every investment is documented through formal legal agreements outlining the investment terms, responsibilities, and exit strategy.

We provide quarterly project updates with progress reports, financial updates, and key milestones.

Investments are made through the entity managing the project in the applicable state, with all terms clearly documented before funding.

We primarily invest in value-add residential real estate, including single-family homes, duplexes, triplexes, and small multifamily properties.

Our typical minimum investment is $50,000, although requirements may vary by opportunity.

Schedule a conversation with us to discuss your goals and determine whether there's an investment opportunity that's a good fit.

Investment opportunities are offered only when available, are subject to applicable laws and investor qualifications, and are governed by executed legal agreements. Past performance does not guarantee future results.
